problem_description: Compute the coordination number in the first solvation shell, average temperature in K, and pressure in bar for a system of 50 urea (UR) molecules solvated in 1987 spce water molecules, and Urea should modeled using the Kirkwood–Buff force-field and the combination rule as 3. The system should simulated in a cubic box of size 4 × 4 × 4 nm³. Energy minimization was performed using the steepest descent algorithm for 50,000 steps using the Verlet cutoff scheme with electrostatic interactions treated using the Particle Mesh Ewald (PME) method with a real-space cutoff of 1.2 nm. Equilibration simulations should be carried out using the md integrator with a time step of 1 fs for 50,000 steps. Temperature was maintained at 300 K using the Nose–Hoover thermostat, and pressure was controlled using the Parrinello–Rahman barostat. Electrostatic interactions were treated using the PME method, and van der Waals interactions employed a cutoff of 1.0 nm. All bonds involving hydrogen atoms were constrained. The production run should also be performed using the md integrator with a time step of 1 fs for 50,000 steps under the same conditions as the equilibration run. Periodic boundary conditions were applied in all directions.
